description: Simulated bench recording (illustrative values): thigh IMU on the hip-knee gait exoskeleton gait_exo_2r, swing leg on the test stand. theta_enc = hip encoder (reference only).
sensor_axes: R_sb = Rot(z, theta): x forward (perpendicular to the thigh), y up the thigh toward the hip, z = hip axis
sampling: gyro sample k = mean rate over (t_k - h, t_k]; accelerometer sample k = value at t_k

imu_spec.note: datasheet-class values of a low-cost 6-axis MEMS IMU
